purpose: Expand independent sessions and market regimes without fitting Entry v2 or weakening PIT, Current Dynamic5m, or Frozen P21.

datasetChange.reason: No authorized long-horizon intraday credential or licensed raw dataset was configured; source semantics must pass an overlap pilot before ingestion.

causalRequirements: All historical outcomes used for selection and refit must have outcomeAt <= decision timestamp.
The row-key intersection must exist across all frozen horizons.
Horizon, feature family, model/config, and threshold are selected from prior-only rows at each decision.
The selected model is refit from prior-only rows; the current row is outcome-free.
Current 5-minute context contains at least six completed same-session bars.
frozenP21PriorDependency.historicalMethodologyEarliestDecisionBlo: Requires an empirical rolling build over older one-minute/five-minute bars for all five frozen-history symbols and must first satisfy the common-horizon 200-row/50-signal selection gates. Static code inspection cannot establish the first eligible session.

jquantsApiMinute.interval: 1 minute; locally aggregatable to 5 minutes only after semantics pass
jquantsApiMinute.coverage: TSE-listed equities; all issues may be requested by date; regional-only issues excluded
jquantsApiMinute.delistedCoverage: Not proven from public minute-endpoint specification; must be tested with date-scoped master and known delistings.
jquantsApiMinute.noTradeSemantics: No record is emitted for a minute with no trading activity; synthetic bars remain forbidden.
jquantsApiMinute.timezone: Tokyo-local Date/Time inferred from TSE product context but must be confirmed in pilot lineage
jquantsApiMinute.timestampSemantics: HH:mm field documented; interval-start versus interval-end availability is not explicitly proven by the public endpoint page
jquantsApiMinute.corporateActionSemantics: Minute endpoint exposes no adjustment factor/adjusted-price fields in the documented response; relationship to daily adjusted data must be tested
jquantsApiMinute.corrections: Provider overwrites corrected data and does not retain versions or expose ETags; immutable local raw SHA-256 snapshots are therefore required
jquantsApiMinute.access: API or CSV with Stock Prices minute/tick add-on
jquantsApiMinute.license: Individual private use only; raw data redistribution is prohibited. Cancellation or downgrade requires deletion of acquired data, copies, and reversible derivatives.

jquantsDataCube.redistribution: available subject to purchased product rights
jquantsDataCube.cost: product-specific; public catalog discovery is insufficient to price a full OHLCV market-wide build
jquantsDataCube.minuteProductFinding: A TSE one-minute closing-price product is listed, but full OHLCV/volume coverage needed by Current Dynamic5m was not verified.

jpxFlexHistorical.dataType: exchange-origin real-time messages/ticks requiring deterministic five-minute aggregation
jpxFlexHistorical.coverage: TSE cash equities and CBs plus issue/base-price information for the relevant service
jpxFlexHistorical.retention: from 2011-01-11; 2010-01-04 onward available only as reference with possible missing portions
jpxFlexHistorical.timestampSemantics: PCAP reception timestamps from 2021-05-24; earlier data are unaltered FLEX text messages
jpxFlexHistorical.delivery: API for last-30-day Regular; AWS S3 for All-period or one-month Spot
jpxFlexHistorical.license: Contract required; external distribution needs an additional license; academic pricing requires application and conditions.

5-minute aggregated OHLC and summed volume against golden context
completed-bar availability at every decision timestamp

overlapPilot.goldenParityImpact: NONE; no provider data was ingested or substituted

historicalUniverse.currentRisk: The existing 2026-06-30 JPX snapshot cannot be projected backward as a complete historical universe.
historicalUniverse.jquantsFeasibility: Date-scoped all-issue minute requests plus date-scoped Listed Issue Master are promising, but delisted, IPO, preferred/common-code, symbol-change, halt, and no-trade coverage require pilot and longitudinal audit.
historicalUniverse.currentDynamic5mReplay: CONDITIONALLY_FEASIBLE_AFTER_MARKET-WIDE_DATE_QUERY, FIVE-MINUTE_AGGREGATION, UNIVERSE AUDIT, AND GOLDEN OVERLAP PARITY

sessionExpansion.jquantsTwoYearApproximateTseSessionCapac: approximately 480-500 sessions before causal warm-up and provider/universe blocking; not measured by an API pilot
sessionExpansion.estimateCaveat: Candidate estimates mechanically multiply the current observed yield and are neither performance forecasts nor promises; regime, universe, missing-bar, and causal-prior effects may materially change yield.
sessionExpansion.volatilityRegimeExpansion: LIKELY_PERIOD_FEASIBLE_OVER_TWO_YEARS_BUT_UNPROVEN_UNTIL INGESTION; fixed regime thresholds must not be retuned
sessionExpansion.untouchedOosReservation: No historical reconstruction is Untouched OOS. The first three eligible future sessions after model and threshold freeze remain reserved.

resolvedThisRun: Frozen P21 prior-history dependency is code-level specified.
Current baseline forward replay and historical causal methodology reconstruction are structurally separated.
Long-horizon official provider options and their adoption blockers are inventoried.
30/50/100-session period feasibility is bounded without pretending the data are ready.
remainingBlockers: No authorized long-horizon intraday dataset has passed overlap parity.
Earliest eligible historical-methodology decision is not empirically established.
Historical universe and delisted/symbol-change coverage remain unverified.
Session count remains 16 and volatility regimes remain NORMAL_VOL-only.
No unused Untouched OOS session exists in the inspected period.
phase0Reaudit.highestValueNextStep: With separately confirmed private-use rights and an already configured credential, run the bounded read-only J-Quants minute overlap pilot on the fixed manifest; otherwise obtain a licensed equivalent dataset outside this code change.
